disclosure.noAccount: It needs no account, and your answer stays on this PC.
disclosure.what: Saying yes sends your games to a private pool that Sensei Top's own stats are built from. That means the games already in your history and the ones you play from now on. Before a game leaves this PC, everything that names you or your opponent is removed, and it's sent without your sign-in.
disclosure.where: The pool is kept in Brazil, with no link to any account.
disclosure.final: Nothing in a sent game says who sent it. Once it's sent, it can't be shown to you, copied or deleted, not even by deleting your account.
disclosure.stop: You can turn it off at any time in Settings, and nothing more is sent after that.

age.label: I'm 13 or older. If I'm under 18, a parent or guardian has said I can send my games.
age.small: This PC keeps that you confirmed this, and when.

hint.age: To send your games, first confirm your age above.
hint.waitsWelcome: Answer each question above to go to Home.

failure.notSaved: Your answer wasn't saved, and no game is sent. Try again.
failure.stillSending: Your answer wasn't saved, so your games are still being sent. Try again.
